demonstrates: Built the submission layer that eight research projects run on against a shared 102-user GPU cluster, encoding its expensive failure modes as rules that execute -- a non-skippable preflight, an enforced budget, and a ledger that answers which job produced a given artifact.

claims.note: Distinct users holding jobs when the package was measured against HPC3. A single observation of a shared cluster, which the article says on the page.
